name: Blackstone Inc.
monetization: Largest alternative asset manager; monetizes AI as landlord and lender to the buildout — owned data-center platforms (QTS, AirTrunk), project equity (Saline Township), frontier-lab equity (Anthropic), and Nvidia's financing coalition.
description_md: Blackstone is the world's largest alternative asset manager and one of the earliest institutional owners of the AI real-asset layer: it took QTS private for ~$10B in 2021 (then the largest data-center deal ever) and, with CPP Investments, acquired APAC operator AirTrunk for A$24B (~$16B) in 2024. Its data-center tenants include the major hyperscalers and ByteDance.
ai_monetization_md: AI-exposure thesis: own the shells and power the tenants can't build fast enough, and increasingly finance them too. Platform equity (QTS — now among the largest US hyperscale developers — and AirTrunk with >1.8GW APAC pipeline); project equity in Related Digital's $16.3B Saline Township campus for Oracle/Stargate (closed Apr 2026); a participation in Anthropic's $65B Series H (May 2026, amount undisclosed); and membership in Nvidia's >$500B compute-collateralized customer-financing coalition (Aug 2026, subject to final agreements).
risk_notes_md: Data-center platform valuations embed continued hyperscaler leasing at current rates; a capex slowdown hits both rents and exit multiples. The coalition would add GPU-collateralized credit exposure on top of landlord exposure to the same demand cycle. Fund-level leverage on QTS/AirTrunk is not fully public.

observations.notes: A$24B including debt and committed projects, with CPP Investments; largest data-center deal globally at signing.
2021 take-private; QTS capacity has multiplied severalfold under Blackstone ownership during the AI cycle.
Named participant in the $65B round at $965B post-money; individual amount undisclosed.

events.title: Agrees to acquire AirTrunk for A$24B (with CPP Investments)
events.why_it_matters: Gave Blackstone the dominant APAC hyperscale platform just as AI demand hit the region; tenants include AWS, Microsoft, ByteDance.

events.title: Provides equity in $16.3B Saline Township financing for Oracle campus
events.why_it_matters: Blackstone-affiliated funds took project equity in the largest single-facility tech debt package on record (PIMCO-anchored), for a >1GW Stargate-serving campus.

events.title: Joins Nvidia's >$500B customer-financing coalition
events.why_it_matters: Moves Blackstone from landlord to GPU-collateralized lender for Nvidia's customer base — layering credit exposure on top of real-asset exposure to the same cycle.
